quest.title: Mondstadters in Liyue
quest.description: Freki and Geri are getting a little homesick...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Festive Fever x100

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: But how do we make Xiao Lanterns? Do you have any idea, Freki?

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Nope, no idea... Should we get someone else to make one for us?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, you two want to release a Xiao Lantern, too?

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you, Traveler. And yes, we were thinking about doing just that.

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: We originally intended to try out the food available during the Lantern Rite. But Geri said that he also wanted to release a lantern to catch a bit of that festive spirit.

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: W—Well, yes! I mean, you have to immerse yourself in the festive spirit first, then eat some festive food. That's the proper way to experience it!

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: I've also heard that you can wish on those lanterns, or something... Neither of us knows how to make one, though.

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Traveler, could we trouble you to make one of these Xiao Lanterns for us?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm on it.

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Wonderful! We'll wait for you here, then.

talks.objective: Give a Xiao Lantern to Freki

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Have you finished making that lantern?

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Thank you. Now, this is the part where we write a wish on it, right?

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Hmm... So, uh, let me think. What should we write?

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: ...That should do it. Now, as for letting the lantern carry our wishes high into the sky...

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Back in Mondstadt, we'd tell the dandelions what was on our minds before scattering their seeds to the wind...

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: Now that you mention it, I do rather miss Mondstadt. It's been a while since we've seen any dandelions, too...

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Traveler, could you help us out again, this time to bring us some Dandelion Seeds?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got this.

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help! Just bring them right here once you've got them.

talks.objective: Give a set of Dandelions Seeds to Freki

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Have you got some Dandelion Seeds?

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: Thank you. Strange, we haven't been away from Mondstadt for very long, and yet we're already missing home.

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: I wonder how everyone back home's doing...

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: Well, now's a good time... Do you have any wishes, Freki?

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Me? Let me think...

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Well, this should do it. Traveler, I've got one more thing to ask of you.

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Dandelion Seeds need to be scattered from a high vantage point to fly far, but Liyue's architecture is very different from Mondstadt's, and we're not sure how to get to the high ground...

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Could you help us find some high ground from which to scatter these Dandelion Seeds?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got your back.

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: We'll be leaving it to you, then.

talks.objective: Find somewhere to scatter the dandelions seeds

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: Freki, when will we be able to return to Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Hmm... Let's leave it a while longer. It wasn't that long ago that we left...

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Hello, Traveler. Have you scattered those Dandelion Seeds yet?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, I've scattered them.

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Great! Let's hope that the wind carries them all the way back to Mondstadt...

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: Well, you were the one who said that we should blend in here... But in the end, it seems like even you can't shake your old Mondstadt habits. So, how about we go track down some Mondstadt snacks today...

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: That won't do at all.

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: Eh? ...Eh?

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Hey, now. Keeping our own customs alive and blending in here in Liyue are two completely different things. Come on, let's go release that Xiao Lantern.

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Have you written your wish down? Let's release this lantern and go grab some festive snacks!

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: I—I'm done writing my wish... but do we really have to eat more local snacks?

dialogues.speaker: Freki
dialogues.text: Haha, of course! Liyue's Lantern Rite specialty snacks, here we come! We mustn't miss out!
